READ	SELECT udf(x) FROM (VALUES (1), (2), (NULL)) v(x)
READ	SELECT udf(x) FROM (VALUES ('A'), ('B'), (NULL)) v(x)
READ	SELECT udf(x) FROM (VALUES ('NaN'), ('1'), ('2')) v(x)
READ	SELECT udf(x) FROM (VALUES ('Infinity'), ('1'), ('2')) v(x)
READ	SELECT udf(x) FROM (VALUES ('-Infinity'), ('1'), ('2')) v(x)
READ	SELECT udf(x) FROM (VALUES 0.00000001, 0.00000002, 0.00000003) v(x)
